body.name: transported bounded-ratio fixed-rank closed-range chart
body.construction: \(\mathcal U_P=\{P'\in\mathcal V_P:c\le p'/p\le C,\ \widetilde T_a(P')=J_{G,a}(P')T_a(P')J_W(P')^{-1}\text{ varies continuously in operator norm},\ \dim\ker\widetilde T_a(P')\text{ and }\dim\ker\widetilde T_a(P')^*\text{ equal their base-law values},\ \mu_a(P')\ge\underline\mu_a,\ a=0,1\}\). The chart domain \(\mathcal V_P\) is not asserted to be Hellinger-open.
